# HY Apps: full app descriptions

> HY Apps is an independent studio (one developer) making calm apps and games for iPhone and iPad: any ads are rare and
> wait for a break, no tracking, no accounts. Contact: hyapps@outlook.com. Short index: https://hyapps.app/llms.txt

## Pyramid Craft: Brick Builder

- Page: https://hyapps.app/pyramidcraft/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/pyramidcraft/privacy.html
- Title: Pyramid Craft: Brick Builder · Build the pyramids of ancient Egypt brick by brick (iPhone)
- Platform: iOS 18 or later

Pyramid Craft is an offline pyramid building game for iPhone. Dig Nile mud, mould and dry bricks in the sun, carry them up and lay three monuments layer by layer, from a mudbrick tomb to the Great Pyramid. Hire workers, build ramps, water wheels and conveyor belts.

Features:
- Every brick by hand: Mud from the river, a wooden mould, the sun to dry it, and your own hands to set it in the layer.
- Ramps and a hand cart: Climb the steps you built, lay ramps up the sides and push a cart full of bricks to the top.
- Workers with jobs: Hire workers and make them diggers, moulders, carriers or masons. Each needs a hut of their own.
- Water wheels and belts: Wheels on the Nile turn conveyor belts that carry mud to automatic moulds and bricks to the stores.
- A mastery tree: Bricks earn mastery: stronger arms, faster drying, bigger loads, ramps, belts and more.
- Calm and offline: No internet, no timers chasing you. A slow sunset over the dunes and the Nile.

Questions and answers:

Q: Is Pyramid Craft free?
A: Yes. It is free to play, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Q: Does it need the internet?
A: No. The whole game plays offline. Game Center leaderboards update when you are online.

Q: How do I play?
A: Walk with the stick on the left and look around by dragging on the right side of the screen. The big button does whatever you are looking at: dig mud, pour it into a mould, take dry bricks, lay them. Follow the tasks and the gold arrow at the start.

Q: Does the game go on while it is closed?
A: No. Nothing happens while the game is closed; you carry on exactly where you left off.

Q: I got stuck somewhere. What can I do?
A: Jump up one brick with the Jump button. If you are boxed in by your own buildings, open Build and take one down with Remove.

Q: Will my progress move to my new phone?
A: Yes. The game keeps a backup in your own iCloud. Sign in with the same Apple Account and iCloud on the new phone.

Q: Is it suitable for children?
A: Pyramid Craft has no violence, no chat, no account, no ads and no in-app purchases.


## Glowfly

- Page: https://hyapps.app/glowfly/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/glowfly/privacy.html
- Title: Glowfly: Idle Brick Breaker · A relaxing idle game of fireflies, light and night skies (iPhone & iPad)
- Platform: iOS 18 or later

Glowfly is a relaxing idle merge game for iPhone and iPad. Fireflies of light bounce through the dark, break glass walls and reveal a hand-drawn night landscape. Merge ten lights into a brighter one, find the fallen stars across 10 chapters and 1,000 nights. It keeps playing while you're away.

Features:
- Merge into brighter light: Ten lights merge into one stronger light. Twelve kinds of light, each brighter and more beautiful than the last.
- A story told in postcards: Every ten nights Lumi finds a fallen star and a postcard joins your story: a cabin in the woods, a lighthouse, a sleeping town, the Milky Way.
- Plays while you're away: Your lights keep working for hours after you close the game. Come back to nights cleared and light to collect.
- Glass, rock and hard stone: Thin glass shatters at a touch, big rocks take a beating. Tap the walls yourself or hold to speed everything up.
- Skills and upgrades: Level up each light, pick a skill at levels 5, 20 and 40, and strengthen all your lights at once.
- Calm by design: Soft lo-fi music, gentle glass sounds and no timers chasing you. Ads only ever play when you choose to watch one for a reward.

Questions and answers:

Q: Is Glowfly free?
A: Yes, Glowfly is free to play from the first night to the last. Glowfly Plus (an optional subscription), an ad-free option and gem packs are available as in-app purchases; prices are always shown on the button before you buy.

Q: Does the game keep going when it's closed?
A: Yes. Your lights keep breaking walls for 4 hours after you leave (longer with Deep Sleep or Glowfly Plus). When you come back, the game shows how many nights were cleared and the light you earned.

Q: Are there ads?
A: Only if you want them. Some rewards, like a boost, can be earned by watching a short video ad. No ad ever plays on its own, and with Plus or the ad-free option you get those rewards without ads.

Q: What is in a Star Box?
A: Boxes drop from the sky now and then and at every chapter end. The game lists exactly what a box can contain and the chance of each prize before you open one.

Q: Will my progress move to my new phone?
A: Yes. The game keeps a backup in your own iCloud. Purchases come back with Restore Purchases on the Glowfly Plus screen.

Q: Is it suitable for children?
A: Glowfly has no violence, no chat and no account. In-app purchases are protected by your Apple Account and Screen Time settings.


## Brickhaven

- Page: https://hyapps.app/brickhaven/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/brickhaven/privacy.html
- Title: Brickhaven: Cozy Brick Builder · Build a seaside town one brick at a time (iPhone & iPad)
- Platform: iOS 18 or later

Brickhaven is a cozy first-person building game for iPhone and iPad. Find the right brick, carry it, lay it, and rebuild Grandma Rose's seaside town one building at a time. Offline, no timers, no ads.

Questions and answers:

Q: Is Brickhaven free?
A: The first two buildings, the Bakery and the Red Barn, are free. The Whole Town is a one-time purchase that opens every other building, the Architect's Table and Decorate. There is no subscription and there are no ads.

Q: Does it need an internet connection?
A: No. Brickhaven plays fully offline. Purchases, iCloud sync and Game Center use the internet when it is there.

Q: Will my town move to my new phone or iPad?
A: Yes. Your saves are kept in your own iCloud, so signing in with the same Apple Account brings them along.

Q: I bought it on another device. How do I get it back?
A: Open the purchase screen and tap Restore. Purchases are also shared with your Family Sharing group.

Q: Is there a mode for color blindness?
A: Yes: Settings → Color-blind mode prints a small symbol on every brick color, so shapes, not colors alone, tell them apart.

Q: How much does the Whole Town cost?
A: The current price for your country is shown on the App Store page and on the purchase screen in the game. Prices differ by country and can change for seasonal offers, so this page does not list them.

Q: What does Deluxe add?
A: Deluxe includes the Whole Town plus supporter extras: four special brick colors for the Architect's Table (gold, marble, midnight blue and moss), a dog or cat companion that follows you around, and Rose's Garden decorations such as a gazebo, greenhouse, fountain and rose arch. If you already own the Whole Town you can upgrade to Deluxe.

Q: Does Brickhaven have ads?
A: No. There are no ads of any kind, no energy bars and no timers that make you wait.

Q: Does it work without internet?
A: Yes. Brickhaven plays fully offline, so it works on a plane, on the subway or anywhere without signal. Purchases, iCloud sync and Game Center use the internet when it is there.

Q: Can I play on iPad?
A: Yes. Brickhaven runs on iPhone and iPad and is played in landscape on both. One purchase covers both devices with the same Apple Account.

Q: Will my town move to a new phone or iPad?
A: Yes. Your saves are kept in your own iCloud. Sign in with the same Apple Account and your town comes along. The game has three save slots.

Q: I bought it before. How do I get it back?
A: Open the purchase screen or Settings and tap Restore Purchases. Purchases are also shared with your Family Sharing group.

Q: Which languages does Brickhaven support?
A: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese and Korean. The game follows your device language; you can change it per app in the iOS Settings app.

Q: What is the winter season?
A: From 1 December to 15 January the town turns snowy by itself: snow on the grass, roofs and roads, light strings and wreaths on finished buildings, a decorated tree on the square once the Clock Tower is rebuilt, and winter decorations in Decorate. You can switch it off in Settings → Game → Winter look.

Q: My phone gets warm. What can I do?
A: Brickhaven lowers its own graphics a step at a time when the device gets warm, and Low Power Mode makes it lighter still. Settings → Display → Graphics: Normal is the lighter choice. Settings → Display → Frame rate offers Auto, 30 FPS and 60 FPS: 30 FPS keeps the phone cooler and the battery lasts longer, Auto switches to 30 only when the phone is hot or in Low Power Mode.

Q: How long does it take to finish?
A: It depends on how you play. The Bakery is a short tutorial; later buildings have more than a thousand bricks each. There is no rush: nothing runs out while you are away.

Q: Does Brickhaven collect personal data?
A: No. There is no account and no tracking. The App Store version sends only anonymous play statistics and crash reports that are not linked to you. The privacy policy explains it in plain words.

Q: Is it suitable for children?
A: Yes. Brickhaven is rated 4+ and has no violence, chat or ads. Purchases go through the App Store, so Ask to Buy and Screen Time limits apply.


## Birbdoku: Cute Parrot Puzzle

- Page: https://hyapps.app/birbdoku/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/birbdoku/privacy.html
- Title: Birbdoku · Cozy Cockatiel Bird Puzzle Game for iPhone & iPad (Queens logic)
- Platform: iOS 17 or later

Birbdoku is a cozy bird puzzle game for iPhone and iPad with two cockatiels, Pika and Chiko: place one bird in every row, column and color, birds never touch. A Queens-style logic puzzle with a daily board, hints that teach and a streak garden.

Features:
- Two cockatiels: Pika and Chiko fill the board with a different face in every cell and cheer when you get it right.
- Pure logic: Every puzzle has exactly one solution, found by logic alone. No guessing needed.
- A gentle path: From a 4×4 starter board up to 10×10, with hide-and-seek levels and Bird Duo (two birds per line) along the way.
- Daily puzzle: A new 8×8 board every day, the same for everyone. You can also play today's board free in your browser.
- A streak garden: Pika and Chiko's millet grows each day you clear a level; the cockatiels walk, peck and nap in their garden.
- Hints that teach: Hints explain the next logical step instead of just giving the answer. Binoculars find a bird.
- Weekly season and friends: Race up to 49 other players in your weekly group, add friends with a player code and visit their gardens.

Questions and answers:

Q: Is Birbdoku free?
A: Yes. Birbdoku is free to download and every level can be played without paying. It shows ads, and optional in-app purchases remove them or add helpers.

Q: How do I play?
A: Tap a cell once to mark it with an X, tap it twice to place a bird. Every row, every column and every color needs exactly one bird, and birds may not touch, not even diagonally. Drag across the board to mark many cells.

Q: What happens when I place a wrong bird?
A: You lose one of your three feathers. When all three are gone, start the level again or use a revive to carry on.

Q: How does the weekly season work?
A: From level 11, every level you clear adds the feathers you kept (up to 3). You race up to 49 other players in a group of 50. A new season starts every Monday.

Q: Someone has an offensive name in my group.
A: Touch and hold their row in the ranking to report the name or block the player.

Q: Does it need the internet?
A: No for the puzzles. The season ranking and Game Center update when you are online.

Q: Will my progress move to my new phone?
A: Yes. With "Save progress (iCloud)" on, your progress follows your Apple Account.

Q: Is Birbdoku like LinkedIn Queens?
A: Yes, it uses the same rules (also known as Star Battle): one per row, column and colored region, never touching. Birbdoku draws birds instead of crowns and adds a level path, a daily puzzle and hints that explain the logic. It is not affiliated with LinkedIn.

Q: Is there a cockatiel game?
A: Birbdoku stars two cockatiels: Pika, a lutino with a pink bow, and Chiko, a grey cockatiel. They play on the board and live in a garden that grows as you play.

Q: Does it work on iPad?
A: Yes, on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later.

Q: Which languages?
A: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.


## Quick Wits

- Page: https://hyapps.app/quickwits/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/quickwits/privacy.html
- Title: Quick Wits · Party Games & Reaction Games with Friends (iPhone)
- Platform: iOS 17 or later

Quick Wits is a party game of quick skill rounds for iPhone: reflex duels, guessing, memory and group games. Play solo, pass one phone around, or open an online room where everyone plays on their own phone.

Questions and answers:

Q: How many players can play?
A: Solo, up to 8 players passing one phone, or up to 12 in an online room. Group games (Crowd Mind, Lowest Unique, Two Thirds, Same Wavelength) need at least 3 players.

Q: Is it free?
A: Yes. All 87 games, the daily challenge and statistics, solo or with friends, as many matches as you like. No ads, no subscription, no purchases.

Q: Does everyone need the app?
A: For pass-the-phone, only one phone needs it. For an online room, everyone plays on their own phone, so everyone needs Quick Wits.

Q: Do I need an internet connection?
A: Solo, pass-the-phone and the daily challenge work offline, except Map Pin, which needs the internet to load the map. Online rooms need a connection.

Q: What if my phone drops out of an online room?
A: Open the app and join with the same code: you get your seat back and continue from the current round. The host can also choose not to wait.

Q: When does the daily challenge change?
A: Every day at 07:00 UTC, the same moment everywhere, so everyone plays the same five games and rounds and shares one leaderboard.


## Bismillah (Besmele)

- Page: https://hyapps.app/besmele/en/
- Privacy policy: https://hyapps.app/besmele/en/gizlilik.html
- Title: Bismillah · Prayer Times, Quran Audio and Qibla for iPhone
- Platform: iOS

Bismillah is a calm, ad-free companion for prayer times with adhan, the Qur'an with audio and translation, a Qibla compass, a missed prayer tracker, a dhikr counter and a daily verse, hadith and dua.

Questions and answers:

Q: Prayer times differ from my mosque's calendar.
A: The calculation method is chosen automatically for your country. You can change it in Settings → Calculation method.

Q: I don't get notifications.
A: Make sure notifications are on in the app's Settings and allowed in your phone's Settings → Notifications → Bismillah. Notifications are prepared for the next 7 days each time you open the app, so open it now and then.

Q: The Qibla compass looks wrong.
A: Hold your phone flat, away from metal objects and magnetic cases. Moving the phone in a figure 8 a few times recalibrates the compass.

Q: I missed a day. Is my progress lost?
A: No. Your learned names and streak are kept; just continue where you left off.
